en.title: Decode Repeated Groups
en.description:
Decode lowercase letters and (substring){k} repeat groups, with nesting and k=0 allowed.

See "Input" for the standard input/output conventions and constraints added by this site.
en.input: q lines of encoded strings; this site adds that each string and its decoded length are ≤200000, with depth ≤1000.
en.output: Output each decoded string on its own line.
en.explanation: Use an explicit stack to accumulate each level's content; on a closing bracket, append the substring to the parent level the given number of times.
hints: Use an explicit stack to accumulate each level's content; on a closing bracket, append the substring to the parent level the given number of times.
